segments.title: Australia's living naval heritage
segments.summary: This closing assessment explains why Australia's extensive naval heritage rewards a visit and still depends on sustained public support.
segments.body: Australia's naval history is extensive, living, and worth travelling to encounter. It survives because people love and support it, including those actively fighting for its preservation. Historical resources can still be lost when decision-makers fail to understand their value, so continued public attention matters. The passage balances the strength of Australia's naval heritage with its vulnerability to neglect. Open this moment for a concise case for visiting and supporting the country's naval-history sites.

evidence.note: Dr. Clarke calls Australia's naval history spectacular, living, supported, and loved, while urging support for those protecting it from neglect.
